provenance_note: These criteria were fixed before the corrected focal sweep was executed. They are NOT pre-registered from the start of the project: CAM-EXP-009 had already produced a synthetic negative result, and this run exists to validate the solver behind it.
distortion_convention: UNDISTORT_ONCE_INTERNAL - per candidate focal, undistort raw pixels once with that candidate K and the known coefficients; inside the solver distCoeffs is always None. Never undistort twice; never reuse an undistortion made with a different K.

scoring.raw: cv2.projectPoints with distortion vs raw pixels

iteration_provenance: raised from 8 to 32 DURING solver validation, judged only against the positive control at the TRUE focal, before any focal sweep. CAM-EXP-009 used 6.
initialisation: uniform (deployable). Multi-start and true-bone init are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.
normalisation: sum(l) = 1, so absolute hand size is never a cue
seeds: sha256 of the condition name plus BASE_SEED 20261001; Python hash() is never used
primary_identifiability_metric: HELD-OUT reprojection, because free bone proportions can absorb a wrong focal on the frames they were fitted to
control_criterion: correct mapping must beat wrong mapping and subject swap by >= 10 pp absolute focal error OR >= 20 pp within-5%
